name: Sweet Potato Roasted Red Pepper Bisque

ingredients.note: roast on sheet pan until charred, or use jar
add more to thin if desired

ingredients.item: Bragg Liquid Aminos or Himalayan salt

instructions: Roast sweet potatoes on sheet pan in oven until charred. Or use jar roasted peppers.
Cool. Use jar pepper or your roasted ones.
Place all into blender. Blend until smooth. Add water if too thick. Blend in two batches.
Warm on stove. Add chopped fresh basil before serving.
notes: Some ingredient quantities on original card were not fully legible — ginger and ground red pepper amounts need verification.
